semantics: Capacity<80 returns0 before reading cursor, including actual null/unmapped pointer cases. Middle argument is unused. Otherwise reads cursor base, advances cursor by full capacity, builds descriptor at base and returns base.

Creates root atbase+16, preceding busy physical sentinel atbase+32, first free block atbase+48 with capacity-80 bytes and final busy sentinel atbase+capacity-16. All list/boundary tags and descriptor counters are stored in original order; unused backing bytes are retained.
Cursor may alias any tested header DWORD atbase0..48. Later descriptor/header writes intentionally overwrite its consumed value when aliased. Unaligned backing0..3 retains native DWORD stores.
limitations: Prepared writable backing for full capacity80..16384, readable cursor unless early-return branch; private caller stack aliases excluded. No upstream allocation/OS services used.
